items.headline: Witkoff, Kushner meet with Putin to discuss Ukraine war
items.detail: Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke with U.S. special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner for three hours Saturday about the war with Ukraine.

items.headline: Severe weather to impact parts of US over Labor Day weekend
